description: Builds one DMARC record (TXT at _dmarc.<domain>). Start with policy none and a report address (rua), read the reports, then move to quarantine and reject once every legitimate sender passes SPF or DKIM aligned. Free, no network. / Monta o registro DMARC; comece com p=none e suba para quarantine e reject.
